mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_record (user_id, level_id, score, wave, kills, result, duration) VALUES (#{userId}, #{levelId}, #{score}, #{wave}, #{kills}, #{result}, #{duration})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, l.name AS level_name FROM game_record r LEFT JOIN level l ON r.level_id = l.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 50
